title: Kona Sea Adventures

services.name: Fishing
services.desc: Join the Kraken team and experience Kona’s finest charter operation. Our captain and crew will work tirelessly to bring your sport fishing dreams to fruition. Regardless if you are seeking giant blue marlin or simply want to take the family bottom fishing, we’ve got you covered. Kona is home to a unique and truly amazing fishery. On a normal day, you could skip a rock across our lake-like waters and by the tenth skip your stone would be in marlin country. Due to Kona’s steep volcanic drop-off, pelagic fish swim closer to shore than anywhere else on Earth. There has been 1,000-pound marlin caught within minutes of leaving the harbor.
